options.content:
# Thermostat Fleet — Multi-Table Demo

Monte Carlo simulation of two independent DynamoDB tables in a single graph:
- **device-registry**: low-write, read-heavy (customer-support queries and fleet-dashboard scans dominate)
- **device-telemetry**: high-write (continuous IoT telemetry ingest from a growing device fleet)

Panels overlay both tables so you can compare capacity consumption and cost side-by-side across the same simulated time window.

- Batch ID: `${batch_id}`
- Scenario ID: `${scenarioId}`
- Trial Count: `${trialCount}`
- Simulation Ticks: `${simulationTicks}`
- Window Size (s): `${windowSizeSeconds}`

panels.title: Demo Overview

panels.description: Mean total estimated cost per table across all trials, plus one standard deviation.
panels.title: Total Cost per Table

panels.description: Mean read capacity units consumed per time window for each table. The registry table is read-heavy (customer-support queries); the telemetry table consumes fewer reads relative to its write volume.

targets.rawSql:
select
  to_timestamp(window_start_tick) as "time",
  avg("value") as "device-registry"
from stochastacy_demo.trial_window_time_series
where batch_id = '${batch_id}'
  and scenario_id = '${scenarioId}'
  and metric = 'Table:device-registry:ReadCapacityUnits'
  and window_size_seconds = cast('${windowSizeSeconds}' as integer)
  and window_start_tick <= cast('${simulationTicks}' as bigint)
group by window_start_tick
order by window_start_tick;

select
  to_timestamp(window_start_tick) as "time",
  avg("value") as "device-telemetry"
from stochastacy_demo.trial_window_time_series
where batch_id = '${batch_id}'
  and scenario_id = '${scenarioId}'
  and metric = 'Table:device-telemetry:ReadCapacityUnits'
  and window_size_seconds = cast('${windowSizeSeconds}' as integer)
  and window_start_tick <= cast('${simulationTicks}' as bigint)
group by window_start_tick
order by window_start_tick;
